title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,650,986 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022

title: Fire reported near oil refinery in Russia's Rostov Oblast amid Ukrainian drone attack
summary: Ukraine's military launched a drone attack on Russia's Rostov Oblast overnight on Nov. 28, reportedly striking the area near the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Refinery, Telegram monitoring channels reported.

title: 'Normal staffing issue' — IAEA chief dismisses criticism over appointment of sanctioned Russian as deputy
summary: The official in question, Alexey Ferapontov, serves as the deputy head of the Russian Federal Service for Environmental, Technological and Nuclear Supervision. He was sanctioned by Ukraine in February 2023 over his role in "legitimizing the illegal seizure of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant and extending Russian regulatory control over it," according to Ukraine's Foreign Ministry.

title: Russian soldier who was 13 when Russia launched full-scale invasion killed in Ukraine, media reports
summary: It remains unclear when or how he joined the Russian military or where exactly he was killed.

title: Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk injures 4, including 3 children
summary: In Kremenchuk, a Russian drone attack damaged two educational institutions in the city center, Poltava Oblast Governor Vitalii Diakivnych reported.
